keyFindings.description: The Deployments row of the operator table — a row this pull request rewrote — still reads 'The app at `replicas` pods, `Recreate` at one and `RollingUpdate` (`maxUnavailable: 0`, `maxSurge: 1`) above one, with a 30-second termination grace period'. The app pod renders 35 (dispatch_kube.go:312, testdata/dispatch-pod.golden:177, pinned at dispatch_test.go:530), and the same README says 35 at :213. The clause sits inside the app's own clause, before the semicolon that starts the front door and the listener, so no reading of the sentence is true: the app is 35 and the other two set no grace period at all. The row was right at the base, where the pod asked for 30; round 2 raised the number and the row was not carried. Nothing guards README prose — the guard reads the golden, not the documentation — so an operator sizing a release window reads 30 in the table they skim first and 35 seventy lines later, and has to open the golden to break the tie. It is the stale half of the exact number rounds 2 and 3 were spent making honest, which is why it is not batched into the fast-follow: the Fast-follow line holds naming, duplication and wording, and a wrong number is none of those. One word: 30-second -> 35-second. It is the only thing standing; everything else in this pull request is accepted.
